summary: Iteration 5 validated the new Unit 5 (JPEG, MPEG, Huffman, CD/DVD, Streaming/VoD, VR/AR, project stages, file formats). Backend suite extended with TestUnit5 (12 new tests) + units-list count updated 4->5 + unit5 persistence test: 49/49 pytest tests pass against the public URL. Frontend verified on desktop 1920: 5-tab switcher, Unit 5 loads with correct title, 8 sidebar topics/8 topic cards, exactly 6 [data-testid='diagram-frame'] elements (mm-project & file-formats correctly have none), cheat card renders after cover, all 3 solved numericals and 3 comparison tables render with correct values, sidebar nav + scroll-spy active state work, Unit5 -> Unit1 -> Unit5 round trip has zero stale content, zero console/page errors. Only two cosmetic SVG label defects found in the new DiagramsF.jsx.

issues: Text collision: the 'Data glove' label (x=196, y=182, anchor=start) visually overlaps the red 'stereo images + sound' arrow label (x=287, y=178). Both strings are rendered on top of each other and are hard to read. Suggest moving 'Data glove' up/left (e.g. y=196) or shifting the red label to y=196/x=320.

Caption 'CD 700 MB (780 nm) - DVD 4.7 GB (650 nm, smaller pits)' is clipped at the right edge of the SVG viewBox - the trailing ')' is cut off. Reduce font size, shorten the string, or re-centre (x<410 / split into two lines).

action_items: Fix overlapping 'Data glove' / 'stereo images + sound' labels in VRSetupDiagram (DiagramsF.jsx ~lines 141/149).
Fix clipped CD/DVD caption text in CDDVDDiagram (DiagramsF.jsx line 110) so the closing parenthesis is visible.
critical_code_review_comments: No functional issues. content_unit5.py mirrors the unit1-4 schema exactly (analogy/definition/working/quick_facts/memory_trick, optional solved_example/comparison/diagram_key+diagram_caption), so the generic renderers required no changes - good.

MPEG comparison has 4 headers (Point, I-frame, P-frame, B-frame) and only 3 rows while the other Unit 5 tables have 4 rows; row widths all match headers so rendering is fine, but consider adding a 4th row (e.g. 'Compression ratio') for parity with other 5-marker tables.
backend/server.py is small and seeds idempotently; unit listing correctly excludes _id and the heavy topics payload.
seed_data_creation: None - app seeds its own 5 static units on startup; no test data created.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now has 49 tests covering Units 1-5 (TestUnit5 added, units-list asserts 5 units). Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. For frontend diagram counting always use [data-testid='diagram-frame'] (raw svg counts are inflated by lucide icons). Unit 5 expects exactly 6 diagram frames. Mobile and print layouts were validated in earlier iterations and were not re-tested here. Only outstanding items are the two cosmetic SVG label fixes in DiagramsF.jsx.
rca_of_the_issue: Both remaining defects are pure SVG text-positioning oversights in the newly hand-coded DiagramsF.jsx: absolute x/y coordinates were chosen without accounting for rendered string width, causing one label overlap (VR) and one right-edge clip (CD/DVD). No data or API involvement.
